paragraphs.text: 1. O INDRA, in this battle great and glorious, in this loud din of war help us to victory,
paragraphs.original: अस्मिन्न इन्द्र पृत्सुतौ यशस्वति शिमीवति क्रन्दसि प्राव सातये ।
paragraphs.translit: asminna indra pṛtsutau yaśasvati śimīvati krandasi prāva sātaye |

paragraphs.text: Where in the strife for kine among bold ring-decked men arrows fly all around and heroes are subdued.
paragraphs.original: यत्र गोषाता धृषितेषु खादिषु विष्वक्पतन्ति दिद्यवो नृषाह्ये
paragraphs.translit: yatra goṣātā dhṛṣiteṣu khādiṣu viṣvakpatanti didyavo nṛṣāhye

paragraphs.text: 2. At home disclose to us opulence rich in food, streaming with milk, O Indra, meet to be renowned.
paragraphs.original: स नः क्षुमन्तं सदने व्यूर्णुहि गोअर्णसं रयिमिन्द्र श्रवाय्यम् ।
paragraphs.translit: sa naḥ kṣumantaṃ sadane vyūrṇuhi goarṇasaṃ rayimindra śravāyyam |

paragraphs.text: Sakra, may we be thine, the friendly Conqueror's: even as we desire, O Vasu, so do thou.
paragraphs.original: स्याम ते जयतः शक्र मेदिनो यथा वयमुश्मसि तद्वसो कृधि
paragraphs.translit: syāma te jayataḥ śakra medino yathā vayamuśmasi tadvaso kṛdhi

paragraphs.text: 3. The godless man, much-lauded Indra, whether he be Dasa or be Arya, who would war with us,-
paragraphs.original: यो नो दास आर्यो वा पुरुष्टुतादेव इन्द्र युधये चिकेतति ।
paragraphs.translit: yo no dāsa āryo vā puruṣṭutādeva indra yudhaye ciketati |

paragraphs.text: Easy to conquer he for thee, with us, these foes: with thee may we subdue them in the clash of fight.
paragraphs.original: अस्माभिष्टे सुषहाः सन्तु शत्रवस्त्वया वयं तान्वनुयाम संगमे
paragraphs.translit: asmābhiṣṭe suṣahāḥ santu śatravastvayā vayaṃ tānvanuyāma saṃgame

paragraphs.text: 4. Him who must be invoked by many and by few, who standeth nigh with comfort in the war of men,
paragraphs.original: यो दभ्रेभिर्हव्यो यश्च भूरिभिर्यो अभीके वरिवोविन्नृषाह्ये ।
paragraphs.translit: yo dabhrebhirhavyo yaśca bhūribhiryo abhīke varivovinnṛṣāhye |

paragraphs.text: Indra, famed Hero, winner in the deadly strife, let us bring hitherward to-day to favour us.
paragraphs.original: तं विखादे सस्निमद्य श्रुतं नरमर्वाञ्चमिन्द्रमवसे करामहे
paragraphs.translit: taṃ vikhāde sasnimadya śrutaṃ naramarvāñcamindramavase karāmahe

paragraphs.text: 5. For, Indra, I have heard thee called Self. capturer, One, Steer! who never yields, who urges even the churl.
paragraphs.original: स्ववृजं हि त्वामहमिन्द्र शुश्रवानानुदं वृषभ रध्रचोदनम् ।
paragraphs.translit: svavṛjaṃ hi tvāmahamindra śuśravānānudaṃ vṛṣabha radhracodanam |

paragraphs.text: Release thyself from Kutsa and come hither. How shall one like thee sit still bound that he may not move?
paragraphs.original: प्र मुञ्चस्व परि कुत्सादिहा गहि किमु त्वावान्मुष्कयोर्बद्ध आसते
paragraphs.translit: pra muñcasva pari kutsādihā gahi kimu tvāvānmuṣkayorbaddha āsate
